name: robust-transparency-ecg
description: Do interpretable inputs help a frozen ECG foundation model? One age column concatenated to the embedding of each of six open ECG encoders raises one-year-mortality AUROC in all 48 encoder-condition-cohort cells, by up to 0.160, with the largest gains where corruption costs the encoders most.
